FACT-1.gloss: The cost to plant the lemon tree is $90

FACT-4.gloss: The yearly cost to water and feed the tree is $3

FACT-5.gloss: Annual revenue is defined as the product of lemons sold per year and price per lemon

FACT-6.gloss: Net profit is defined as annual revenue minus annual expenses

FACT-7.gloss: Total amount needed to break even is defined as the initial investment plus one year's net profit
FACT-7.verify_reason: The problem does not define break-even total as "initial investment plus one year's net profit"; this is an invented formulation not stated or entailed by the problem.

FACT-8.gloss: Break-even years is defined as total amount needed divided by net profit per year
FACT-8.verify_reason: This definition relies on the unsupported FACT-7 total and is not stated in the problem; the problem only implies years = initial cost / net profit per year.

RULE-1.gloss: The product of two quantities' values equals the value of the product entity

RULE-2.gloss: The difference of two quantities' values equals the value of the difference entity

RULE-3.gloss: The sum of two quantities' values equals the value of the sum entity

RULE-4.gloss: The quotient of two quantities' values equals the value of the quotient entity

RULE-5.gloss: Since Carlos cannot have a fraction of a year in practical terms, a fractional break-even value of 13.33 years must be rounded up to the next whole year, 14
RULE-5.verify_reason: The rule embeds specific numeric values (13.33, 14) that do not correspond to the actual problem's numbers (90/7.5=12), hardcoding an arithmetic result rather than abstracting the rounding relationship as a general rule.

INF-1.gloss: Annual revenue is $10.5, from FACT-5, FACT-2, FACT-3, RULE-1 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-2.gloss: Net profit is $7.5, from FACT-6, INF-1, FACT-4, RULE-2 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-3.gloss: Total amount needed to break even is $97.5, from FACT-7, FACT-1, INF-2, RULE-3 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-4.gloss: Break-even years computed as 13.33, from FACT-8, INF-3, INF-2, RULE-4 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-5.gloss: Carlos needs 14 years to start earning money, from INF-4 and RULE-5 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens
